test_set.english: The failover works, and it holds only under the condition that both regions are up; outside that condition no claim is made.
The parser is fast, and it holds only under the condition of ASCII input; outside that condition no claim is made.
The quota is sufficient, and it holds only under the condition of current traffic; outside that condition no claim is made.
The workaround is safe, and it holds only under the condition that the flag stays off; outside that condition no claim is made.
The estimate is accurate, and it holds only under the condition of last quarter's mix; outside that condition no claim is made.
The cert renews automatically, and it holds only under the condition that DNS stays delegated; outside that condition no claim is made.
The retry is idempotent, and it holds only under the condition of unique request ids; outside that condition no claim is made.
The dashboard is realtime, and it holds only under the condition of the streaming tier; outside that condition no claim is made.
The join is lossless, and it holds only under the condition of enforced foreign keys; outside that condition no claim is made.
The scaler keeps up, and it holds only under the condition of gradual ramps; outside that condition no claim is made.
The mirror is consistent, and it holds only under the condition of single-writer mode; outside that condition no claim is made.
The alert is reliable, and it holds only under the condition that the probe host is external; outside that condition no claim is made.
